Fasting glucose/HbA1c not available – needed to determine pre‑diabetes/diabetes status and justify metformin.
QRISK score not calculated – required to confirm indication for statin per NICE CG181.
Smoking status unknown – influences cardiovascular risk and counseling.

Allergy status not recorded – ensure no hypersensitivity to proposed agents.
treatment_summary: The plan addresses metabolic syndrome by continuing lisinopril for hypertension, initiating atorvastatin for cardiovascular risk reduction, adding amlodipine if BP target is not met, and starting semaglutide for obesity management. Interactions are minimal, and no contraindicated drugs are prescribed. Key investigations (eGFR, LFTs, full lipid panel, fasting glucose/HbA1c, QRISK, smoking/alcohol history) are required before considering metformin or SGLT2‑i. Referral for CPAP therapy and lifestyle interventions (diet, exercise, weight loss, smoking cessation) are also recommended.
